name: Belgrove Residences
overview: Ellington’s Belgrove Residences is set to redefine luxury living in Meydan. With its prime location, contemporary design, and top tier amenities, it offers an unparalleled lifestyle for residents. Whether you’re a young professional, a small family, or a larger family seeking the ultimate in comfort and luxury, Belgrove Residences has a home for you. The perfect blend of city convenience and peaceful living makes this development an exceptional choice for those looking to upgrade their lifestyle in Dubai.
